svg.title: Task 1 objects and predicates
svg.desc: A diagram of the PDDL objects for Task 1, each a red box with its type above it and, in gray below it, the predicates that describe it. From left to right: cells c1 to c4 (at-door); inspection robot 1 (picks-conveyor, hand-free, holding); tester1 and tester2 (tester-free, on-tester, serves); inspection robot 2 (loads-agv, hand-free, holding); and a dashed gray recycling bin, which is not an object (recycled). Below, agv1 with four slots s1 to s4 (agv-at, in-slot, slot-free, kit-checked, submitted), between the station shipping on the left and the station inspection on the right. Arrows with tags: 1 from the cells to inspection robot 1, 2 from it to both testers, 3 from both testers to inspection robot 2, 4 from it down to agv1, 5 from it to the recycling bin. Tag 6 sits left of agv1, an arrow with tag 7 goes from agv1 to shipping, and tag 8 sits left of shipping.
